title: Cross Site Scripting/injection in WeblogPlugin in Apache JSPWIKI on all versions previous to 3.0.1 on all platforms…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the WeblogPlugin of Apache JSPWIKI in all versions prior to 3.0.1. This flaw allows attackers to bypass content encoding mechanisms and inject raw HTML or JavaScript into pages. The issue is fixed in version 3.0.1.
